title: pi-imps configuration
description: Global configuration for pi-imps. Place at ~/.pi/agent/imps.json.

turnLimit.description: Max turns before an imp is cut off. Acts as a circuit breaker for runaway imps.

toolAllowlist.description: Default tool allowlist for all imps. Omit to allow all tools. Agent frontmatter `tools` overrides this per-agent.

additionalExtensions.description: Non-array values, non-string entries, and blank strings fail settings loading; omission or [] is valid. Requested package install commands use global Pi settings only. Explicit Pi extension sources loaded in SDK and Orca imps regardless of discovery/tool filtering: local files/directories, npm: packages (e.g. npm:pi-ward), git: packages, or builtin:codemode. Relative paths, including bare names such as pi-ward, resolve from getAgentDir(), not the imp cwd, and fail if no enabled extension exists there. Unresolvable or unloadable sources, including unsupported or unregistered builtins, fail launch explicitly. Loading never grants tools beyond the resolved allowlist; pi-imps remains excluded and requests to load it are rejected to prevent recursion. Explicit builtin:codemode sources load independently of codemode tool grants; both requests require createCodemodeExtension (Pi SDK >=0.99.2) and fail with actionable SDK upgrade guidance if missing. Ordinary imps without a codemode request continue to work. Agent frontmatter and project config cannot override this.

impFlags.description: Names of boolean flags registered by extensions selected for each imp. No -- prefix or values; invalid flags fail settings loading, and unregistered or non-boolean flags fail imp launch. Applies to local and Orca imps.

agents.description: Per-agent additive tool grants. Keys are agent names. Tools listed here are unioned with the effective base allowlist: agent frontmatter tools when present, otherwise global toolAllowlist.

tools.description: Additional tools to grant this agent beyond its effective base allowlist.

orca.description: Orca-backed external imp launches, used to run imps in separate POSIX current-worktree terminals instead of in-process.

enabled.description: Enable Orca-backed imp launches. Requires darwin/linux and a current Orca worktree; local in-process spawning is used when disabled.
